system.description: You chew a certain herb and mimic the sounds of the local fauna.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, but it lasts until your next Long Rest.
outcomes.success: For 1 hour, you can share simple ideas with animals. You do not just talk: you understand the language of scents, tail-twitches and growls.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the time and herb are lost.
outcomes.ruin: You say something terribly rude: animals within a mile are hostile to you for a day. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
